entries.title: Your first mate keeps its folders when it moves between a Windows PC and a Mac
entries.body: When you move your first mate from a Windows PC to a Mac or a Linux computer, or the other way, each project now arrives in a folder with its own name: in the same place under your home folder when you kept it there, and with the projects the app keeps for you otherwise. Each task points at its project on the new computer, and a conversation the old computer kept for a task is found in its new place. Before, a project from a Windows PC could arrive on a Mac in a folder named after its whole Windows location, and tasks kept pointing at folders that exist only on the old computer. Two projects whose folders share a name now both arrive, side by side, each saved under the name it arrived with.
entries.noPicture: The fix changes where folders land on the disk and which locations the record saves; no view looks different.
